sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，175年来致力于帮助您了解世界，充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受 nytimes.com/subscribe 上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日简报》。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, President Trump asked the Supreme Court to bless his audacious plan to restrict voting by mail just weeks before a high-stakes midterm election.
sentences.zh: 周二，特朗普总统请求最高法院批准他那项大胆的计划，即在关键的中期选举前几周限制邮寄投票。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Nick Corosiniti takes us inside Trump's plan, the legal battle that it's touched off, and the uncertainty that it's created for both local election officials
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事尼克·科罗西尼蒂将带我们深入了解特朗普的计划、由此引发的法律斗争，以及它给地方选举官员带来的不确定性，

sentences.en: and voters across the country.
sentences.zh: 还有全国各地的选民。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, September 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月9日，星期三。

sentences.en: Nick, thank you for making time for us.
sentences.zh: 尼克，谢谢你抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 我的荣幸。

sentences.en: So, looking at the calendar, we are, I believe, just days away in a few states from the official beginning of early voting in this year's midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 那么，看看日历，我相信在一些州，距离今年中期选举提前投票的正式开始只剩下几天了。

sentences.en: And I think, rightfully, a lot of our listeners are confused about the state of mail-in ballots, which have become a huge way that a lot of the country votes
sentences.zh: 我认为，很多听众对邮寄选票的现状感到困惑是理所应当的，因为邮寄选票已经成为全国许多地方的一种重要投票方式，

sentences.en: because of the actions that have been taken by the president and how much they've become tied up in the courts.
sentences.zh: 这归因于总统采取的行动，以及这些行动在法庭上受到的牵制程度。

sentences.en: So, can you just explain the situation that we are in at a very high level?
sentences.zh: 那么，你能从宏观层面解释一下我们目前的处境吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: And one thing really quick is that early voting, in a way, has already begun.
sentences.zh: 有一点要先说明，提前投票在某种程度上已经开始了。

sentences.en: On Friday, North Carolina and Delaware started sending out mail ballots.
sentences.zh: 周五，北卡罗来纳州和特拉华州已经开始寄出邮寄选票。

sentences.en: So, there are ballots that are on their way to voters as we speak.
sentences.zh: 所以，在我们说话的时候，选票已经在寄往选民的路上了。

sentences.en: They're in the system.
sentences.zh: 它们已经在系统里了。

sentences.en: So, they're in the system.
sentences.zh: 没错，它们已经在系统里了。

sentences.en: They're either being processed by the Postal Service or maybe they already arrived.
sentences.zh: 它们要么正在由邮政局处理，要么可能已经送达了。

sentences.en: But where we are in this moment is not to repeatedly use the phrase unprecedented, but something that we've never seen before,
sentences.zh: 但我们现在所处的时刻——不是为了反复使用“前所未有”这个词，而是我们确实从未见过这种情况——

sentences.en: which is the president and the executive branch seeking to leverage an agency, in this case, the United States Postal Service, to change how elections are run.
sentences.zh: 那就是总统和行政部门试图利用一个机构，即美国邮政局，来改变选举的运作方式。

sentences.en: And this stems from an executive order that the president signed earlier this year seeking to restrict mail voting and basically turning the Postal Service
sentences.zh: 这源于总统今年早些时候签署的一项行政命令，旨在限制邮寄投票，并基本上将邮政局

sentences.en: into an arbiter of which states can have mail voting.
sentences.zh: 变成了哪些州可以进行邮寄投票的仲裁者。

sentences.en: Turning the Postal Service, which we usually think of as kind of a neutral
sentences.zh: 将我们通常认为在选举系统中处于中立地位的邮政局，

sentences.en: player in our election system, literally the people who carry the votes to the people who need them and then bring them back to the election offices,
sentences.zh: 也就是那些把选票送到需要的人手中，然后再把选票送回选举办公室的人，

sentences.en: turning that into an organization that gets to decide if your vote ever counts.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个有权决定你的选票是否有效的机构。

sentences.en: Or at least gets to decide whether you can cast your vote.
sentences.zh: 或者至少是有权决定你是否能够投票。

sentences.en: Whether a state can have mail voting at all or whether a voter is able to receive their mail ballot.
sentences.zh: 决定一个州是否可以进行邮寄投票，或者选民是否能够收到他们的邮寄选票。

sentences.en: Turning this agency into this kind of partisan political operator so close to an election is just
sentences.zh: 在临近选举时将这个机构变成这种党派政治的操作工具，这确实是

sentences.en: something we haven't seen, especially in the past decade with mail voting becoming so critical to a large part of the American electorate.
sentences.zh: 我们从未见过的，尤其是在过去十年里，邮寄投票对美国广大选民变得如此关键的情况下。

sentences.en: Just how critical is mail-in voting at this point post-pandemic when I know there was a major increase in mail-in voting?
sentences.zh: 在疫情之后，邮寄投票到底有多关键？我知道邮寄投票曾有过大幅增长。

sentences.en: The pandemic kind of changed everything.
sentences.zh: 疫情改变了一切。

sentences.en: And while mail voting isn't at the same clip that it was in 2020, still nearly 30% of Americans cast a ballot by mail in the 2024 elections.
sentences.zh: 虽然邮寄投票的频率不如2020年，但仍有近30%的美国人在2024年的选举中通过邮寄方式投票。

sentences.en: Now that's tens of millions of voters.
sentences.zh: 那可是数千万选民。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's eight states that conduct their elections almost entirely by mail.
sentences.zh: 有八个州几乎完全通过邮寄方式进行选举。

sentences.en: So there's a large amount of Americans whose votes, you know, are very much wrapped up in this.
sentences.zh: 所以有大量的美国人的选票，你知道，很大程度上都与此相关。

sentences.en: And Nick, is the right way to think about the president's motivation here for mucking around with the role of the Postal Service when it comes to mail-in ballots in this
sentences.zh: 尼克，如果把总统在中期选举中干扰邮政局在邮寄选票方面作用的动机，

sentences.en: midterm election, simply that he's seeking political advantage for Republicans in this election?
sentences.zh: 简单地理解为他是在为共和党寻求政治优势，这种想法对吗？

sentences.en: I mean, the president himself has said, if we can limit mail voting or restrict these mail ballots, then that'll help Republicans win.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，总统本人已经说过，如果我们能限制邮寄投票或限制这些邮寄选票，那将有助于共和党获胜。

sentences.en: So he's been very explicit about this.
sentences.zh: 所以他对此表达得非常明确。

sentences.en: But he's also doubted mail voting for the better part of a decade.
sentences.zh: 但他对邮寄投票的怀疑已经持续了近十年。

sentences.en: I was with him in Colorado in 2016, where he went on a tangent at a campaign event, casting doubt on the mail voting process in that state, a state that conducts its elections
sentences.zh: 2016年我在科罗拉多州陪同他时，他在竞选活动中跑题了，对该州的邮寄投票程序表示怀疑，而该州大部分选举都是通过邮寄进行的。

sentences.en: mostly by mail.
sentences.zh: （该州大部分选举都是通过邮寄进行的。）

sentences.en: And then following his loss in 2020, where scores of Democrats chose to vote by mail to vote safely in the pandemic, the president blamed it for his loss.
sentences.zh: 而在他2020年败选后，由于大量民主党人选择通过邮寄方式在疫情中安全投票，总统将他的失败归咎于此。

sentences.en: And ever since then, he's been obsessed with this idea without any evidence that mail voting is rife with fraud.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他就一直沉迷于这种想法，尽管没有任何证据表明邮寄投票充斥着欺诈。

sentences.en: Well, just explain exactly where we are logistically in the president's attempts to change the role
sentences.zh: 那么，请解释一下总统在这些中期选举中试图改变邮政局作用的物流现状，

sentences.en: of the Postal Service in these midterm elections and where all his efforts stand legally.
sentences.zh: 以及他所有的努力在法律上处于什么位置。

sentences.en: To understand exactly where we're at, we have to go back to last year.
sentences.zh: 要准确理解我们所处的位置，我们必须回到去年。

sentences.en: The president is clearly realizing that the midterms are moving away from him.
sentences.zh: 总统显然意识到中期选举正在离他而去。

sentences.en: There's a lot going on politically against President Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在政治上正面临很多麻烦。

sentences.en: Stubborn and rising inflation.
sentences.zh: 顽固且不断上涨的通货膨胀。

sentences.en: There was backlash against ice raids happening in American cities.
sentences.zh: 美国城市中发生的针对移民执法局（ICE）突袭行动的强烈反对。

sentences.en: Reverberation still from Doge.
sentences.zh: “Doge”事件带来的持续反响。

sentences.en: And so he starts looking at different ways to leverage all of the different agencies within
sentences.zh: 因此，他开始寻找不同的方法来利用他权力范围内的所有不同机构，

sentences.en: his power, whether that's the Department of Justice, the Department of Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 无论是司法部还是国土安全部。

sentences.en: He's using all of these to shape the elections.
sentences.zh: 他正在利用所有这些来影响选举。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢。

sentences.en: This was a meeting set up.
sentences.zh: 这是一次安排好的会议。

sentences.en: Very proud.
sentences.zh: 非常自豪。

sentences.en: So fast forward to March, and that's where the Postal Service comes into play.
sentences.zh: 快进到三月，这就是邮政局发挥作用的地方。

sentences.en: Because the cheating on mail-in voting is legendary.
sentences.zh: 因为邮寄投票中的作弊行为是传奇性的。

sentences.en: It's horrible what's going on.
sentences.zh: 正在发生的事情太可怕了。

sentences.en: But the White House announces that President Trump will be making big changes to the way that the Postal Service interacts with the election system.
sentences.zh: 但白宫宣布，特朗普总统将对邮政局与选举系统的互动方式做出重大改变。

sentences.en: So with all of that, I'm very happy to be signing the voter integrity.
sentences.zh: 所以，有了这一切，我非常高兴能签署这项选民诚信法案。

sentences.en: And I think it's going to be really great.
sentences.zh: 我认为这会非常棒。

sentences.en: So if you don't mind, I will take some time and I'll make this signature absolutely perfect.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你不介意的话，我会花点时间，把这个签名签得完美无缺。

sentences.en: He signs an executive order that does a host of things regarding mail voting.
sentences.zh: 他签署了一项行政命令，在邮寄投票方面做了很多事情。

sentences.en: So far, so good.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，一切顺利。

sentences.en: So the two most important parts of this executive order empower the Postal Service to play a really decisive role in mail voting.
sentences.zh: 这项行政命令中最重要的两个部分是授权邮政局在邮寄投票中发挥决定性作用。

sentences.en: Now, the first part sets some ballot design and envelope design and barcode design regulations
sentences.zh: 第一部分设定了一些选票设计、信封设计和条形码设计的法规，

sentences.en: that are extremely strict and would require some states and some counties to redesign their
sentences.zh: 这些法规极其严格，将要求一些州和县重新设计他们的

sentences.en: ballots, and then also any errors in that design or even in those matches between a barcode and a voter could result in thousands of voters not getting their ballots.
sentences.zh: 选票，而且这种设计上的任何错误，甚至是条形码与选民匹配上的错误，都可能导致成千上万的选民无法收到选票。

sentences.en: So there's pretty critical powers being given to the Postal Service as an arbiter here.
sentences.zh: 所以，作为仲裁者，邮政局被赋予了相当关键的权力。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So the first part of this is about ballot design, which, from what you're saying, could very much have an impact, but it doesn't seem like the heart of this plan.
sentences.zh: 所以第一部分是关于选票设计的，从你的话来看，这可能会产生很大的影响，但它似乎不是这个计划的核心。

sentences.en: So what is the second element of this executive order?
sentences.zh: 那么这项行政命令的第二个要素是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the second element really is the heart of it, or it's at least the thing that people are
sentences.zh: 嗯，第二个要素确实是核心，或者至少是人们谈论最多的部分。

sentences.en: talking about the moSt. And what it is is a requirement that states upload lists of voters who will be eligible to vote by mail.
sentences.zh: 它的要求是各州上传有资格进行邮寄投票的选民名单。

sentences.en: And then they'd have to upload this list to a portal that would be created by and maintained by the Postal Service.
sentences.zh: 然后他们必须将这份名单上传到一个由邮政局创建和维护的门户网站上。

sentences.en: And only those voters on those state lists could receive a mail ballot.
sentences.zh: 只有名单上的那些选民才能收到邮寄选票。

sentences.en: So the Postal Service interprets that part of the executive order to mean that if a state doesn't upload their data, then they will get no mail voting.
sentences.zh: 因此，邮政局对行政命令那部分的解释是，如果一个州不上传数据，那么他们将无法进行邮寄投票。

sentences.en: That means no mail-in ballots will go out if a state doesn't comply and upload their voter data.
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果一个州不遵守规定并上传选民数据，就不会有邮寄选票发出。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: In other words, comply or something like a third of the way people in your state vote is just obliterated from this year's midterMs.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，如果不遵守，那么你所在州三分之一的投票方式就会在今年的中期选举中被抹去。

sentences.en: Yeah, a third of the way the country, it varies state to state.
sentences.zh: 是的，全国三分之一的投票方式，各州情况不同。

sentences.en: And, you know, in some states, this is the entire election, right?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在一些州，这就是整个选举，对吧？

sentences.en: In a mail voting state like Colorado or Washington, they'd be in a lot of trouble.
sentences.zh: 在像科罗拉多州或华盛顿州这样的邮寄投票州，他们会陷入大麻烦。

sentences.en: Putting aside for just a moment the president's desire to create structural advantages for Republicans in this election.
sentences.zh: 暂时撇开总统想要在这次选举中为共和党创造结构性优势的愿望不谈。

sentences.en: What theoretical case could be made for the two elements of this executive order, especially for these state voter rolls, do you think?
sentences.zh: 你认为对于这项行政命令的两个要素，尤其是针对这些州选民名单的要素，有什么理论上的理由可以支持吗？

sentences.en: I mean, would those around the president say that this is a pretty effective way to make sure that only eligible voters vote?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，总统身边的人会说这是确保只有合格选民投票的有效方法吗？

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: They're claiming this is election integrity measures seeking to ferret out fraud in American elections, even if it is exceptionally, exceptionally rare.
sentences.zh: 他们声称这是为了在选举中找出欺诈行为的选民诚信措施，即使这种欺诈极其、极其罕见。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: But the states vehemently disagree with that assessment.
sentences.zh: 但各州强烈反对这种评估。

sentences.en: There's, you know, 24 states, all controlled by Democrats, who pretty much immediately sued, saying that this was an overreach,
sentences.zh: 你知道，有24个由民主党控制的州几乎立即提起诉讼，称这是越权，

sentences.en: a power grab, and attempting to eject politics and partisanship into the administration of American elections.
sentences.zh: 是权力掠夺，并试图将政治和党派偏见注入美国选举的管理中。

sentences.en: And they're pointing to something that's very important to remember here.
sentences.zh: 他们指出了这里非常重要的一点。

sentences.en: The Constitution grants the executive branch, which includes the president, zero explicit authority over elections.
sentences.zh: 宪法赋予行政部门（包括总统）对选举的明确权力为零。

sentences.en: It is left to the states to administer the time, place, and manner of elections.
sentences.zh: 选举的时间、地点和方式由各州管理。

sentences.en: Now, Congress can pass election law that could supersede that, but that's it.
sentences.zh: 现在，国会可以通过可能取代这一点的选举法，但仅此而已。

sentences.en: They say, legally speaking, this is just way out of the executive branch's purview.
sentences.zh: 他们说，从法律上讲，这完全超出了行政部门的职权范围。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 这是违宪的。

sentences.en: But they also have very clear practical concerns here.
sentences.zh: 但他们在这里也有非常明确的实际担忧。

sentences.en: Primarily, this would require significant changes to how they run elections.
sentences.zh: 首先，这将要求他们改变选举运作方式，而这需要重大调整。

sentences.en: And elections are underfunded, run on a tight budget with thin staff.
sentences.zh: 选举资金不足，在预算紧张和人手不足的情况下运行。

sentences.en: So to change ballots, to create a new database, regardless of the political worries or the distrust of the federal government, there's just extreme practical limitations here.
sentences.zh: 所以要改变选票、建立新数据库，无论政治上的担忧或对联邦政府的不信任如何，这里都存在极端的实际限制。

sentences.en: And that's not even getting to where we are in the calendar.
sentences.zh: 而且这还没提到我们现在所处的日历时间。

sentences.en: So these states aren't sure they could compile a list, change their ballot design,
sentences.zh: 所以这些州不确定他们是否能在距离选举不到60天的时间里编制名单、改变选票设计、

sentences.en: make all of these changes to how they're carrying out an election with less than 60 days to go before it.
sentences.zh: 对他们执行选举的方式做出所有这些改变。

sentences.en: That's just not something that's done.
sentences.zh: 这根本不是能做到的事情。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And at the same time, there's not even a front-facing portal from the Postal Service yet that they could upload these lists into.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，邮政局甚至还没有一个面向公众的门户网站，让他们可以上传这些名单。

sentences.en: So from the state's point of view, they have extreme political and policy-level disagreements with it.
sentences.zh: 所以从各州的观点来看，他们对此有极端的政治和政策层面的分歧。

sentences.en: But there's also the practical challenges of making any of this work this close to an election.
sentences.zh: 但还有在临近选举时让这一切运作起来的实际挑战。

sentences.en: Nick, does it seem like the Trump administration has put these Democratic states into an impossible
sentences.zh: 尼克，特朗普政府似乎把这些民主党州置于一个不可能的境地，

sentences.en: situation where they know that those states won't comply with this executive order, and therefore
sentences.zh: 他们知道这些州不会遵守这项行政命令，因此

sentences.en: its practical impact is to prevent mail-in voting for those states' largely Democratic electorate, which is very advantageous for the Trump administration in these midterms?
